title: 阿里國際站 - 六圖完整框架
description: 基於實戰經驗的商品圖片生成系統，同時支援 B2B 工業品和消費品兩大框架

prompts.name: 框架選擇指南
prompts.description: 幫助商家判斷使用 B2B 工業品還是消費品框架
prompts.template:
請根據以下判斷選擇框架：

**框架A - B2B 工業品**
適用於：模具、機械、五金、電子零件、建材、化工、設備
核心目標：用數據和技術背書建立信任，消除採購風險
主要買家：工廠、採購方、企業
視覺重點：精度、品質、認證、生產能力

**框架B - 消費品**
適用於：服裝、家居、美妝、食品、玩具、禮品、運動
核心目標：用視覺故事燃起市場潛力，展示供應鏈專業
主要買家：終端消費者、零售商
視覺重點：生活方式、使用場景、品牌故事、質感

請告訴我你的產品屬於哪一類？
- 選 A - B2B 工業品
- 選 B - 消費品

prompts.name: B2B工業品 - 視覺風格選擇
prompts.description: 為 B2B 工業品提供三種風格選項
prompts.template:
請為你的 B2B 工業品選擇視覺風格。我將根據選擇生成整套六張圖片。

---

**風格 A - 專業冷調工業風**
色調：深灰 (#1F3A5F)、金屬銀、安全橙 (#FF6F00)
背景：工廠環境、金屬台面、深色無縫背景
字體：Montserrat Bold
適合買家：歐洲、日韓採購方
感覺：高冷、專業、技術感強

---

**風格 B - 乾淨簡約商務風**
色調：白、淺灰、深藍點綴
背景：白色無縫背景、簡潔商務環境
字體：Montserrat Bold
適合買家：北美買家、全球通用
感覺：現代、高效、值得信賴

---

**風格 C - 場景化情境風**
色調：自然光暖調、工廠環境色
背景：實際生產線、工廠現場
字體：Inter
適合買家：想看真實工廠環境的買家
感覺：透明、實在、工藝可見

---

請選擇：A / B / C

prompts.name: 消費品 - 視覺風格選擇
prompts.description: 為消費品提供三種風格選項
prompts.template:
請為你的消費品選擇視覺風格。我將根據選擇生成整套六張圖片。

---

**風格 A - 現代簡約生活風**
色調：白、米色、莫蘭迪色系
背景：居家場景、木質台面、自然光
字體：Raleway / Playfair Display
適合：歐美家居買家
感覺：高級感、精緻、生活品味

---

**風格 B - 活力流行時尚風**
色調：飽和色、撞色、品牌主色
背景：街頭場景、棚拍白底、色塊背景
字體：Bebas Neue / 無襯線粗體
適合：服飾、年輕消費品買家
感覺：潮、年輕、充滿能量

---

**風格 C - 自然有機質感風**
色調：大地色、綠色、原木色
背景：戶外場景、天然材質台面
字體：手寫體 / 細襯線
適合：食品、美妝、有機品買家
感覺：純樸、自然、值得信賴

---

請選擇：A / B / C

prompts.name: 圖1｜產品主圖 (Hero Shot)
prompts.description: 第一眼抓住買家，清楚展示產品外觀與質感

templates.b2b:
Professional product photograph of {product_name} placed on {background}.
{lighting_description}. Sharp focus on product details, highlighting surface finish and precision.
Style: clean industrial, {style_colors}.
Text overlay: {product_english_name} | {certification_marks}
Montserrat Bold labels. High resolution, B2B commercial quality.
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.
templates.consumer:
Lifestyle product photography of {product_name} in {ideal_usage_scene}.
{lighting_description}.
Style: {style_name}, high-end commercial photography.
Product is the clear hero of the shot.
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.

prompts.tips:
- 對於 B2B：突出產品的精度細節、表面質感、工藝
- 對於消費品：展現產品在理想場景中的美感
- 光線很關鍵：均勻、專業的攝影棚光線
- 不要加太多文字，讓產品成為絕對主角

prompts.name: 圖2｜痛點洞察圖 (Pain Point)
prompts.description: 不直接賣產品，呈現買家供應鏈中的慘痛教訓，引發共鳴

templates.b2b:
A realistic workplace photo showing {pain_scenario}.
The atmosphere feels tense and problematic. {lighting_description}.
Leave a clean area at the bottom for text overlay.
Text overlay: "{pain_point_question}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.
templates.consumer:
A realistic photo showing {pain_scenario}.
Mood: slightly frustrated, relatable. Natural lighting.
Leave space at bottom for text overlay.
Text overlay: "{pain_point_question}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.

pain_scenarios.precision: a frustrated engineer inspecting defective components with visible dimensional errors on a factory floor
pain_scenarios.delivery_delay: a factory floor during overtime work, with calendar showing delayed deadlines, management looking anxious
pain_scenarios.communication: email threads piling up, documents scattered, miscommunication causing rework
pain_scenarios.quality_unstable: same batch products with visible color or quality differences being compared
pain_scenarios.poor_afterservice: customer service phone calls unanswered, emails getting no response

prompts.tips:
- 題目必須以問句結尾，引發買家思考
- 場景要真實、有張力，但不過度戲劇化
- 這是情感連結的第一步，為接下來的解決方案做鋪墊
- 範例問句："Is Your Supplier Costing You More Than You Think?"

prompts.name: 圖3｜聯繫理由圖 (Why Now)
prompts.description: 承接痛點，展現問題被解決後的正向情境，說明為什麼現在選擇我們

templates.b2b:
A professional photograph showing {solution_scenario}.
Mood: professional, trustworthy, reassuring. {lighting_description}.
{certifications_visible}
Leave space at top for text overlay.
Text overlay: "{core_proposition}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.
templates.consumer:
A bright, optimistic lifestyle photo showing {solution_scenario}.
Mood: relieved, confident, excited. Warm natural lighting.
Leave space at top for text overlay.
Text overlay: "{solution_tagline}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.

example_scenarios.b2b: a confident quality control engineer approving a flawless precision component in a clean modern factory
example_scenarios.consumer: a happy store owner receiving a perfectly packaged shipment, opening a box of consistent, beautiful products with a smile

prompts.tips:
- 這是機會圖，展示解決問題後的理想狀態
- 讓買家看到與你合作的美好未來
- 標語要簡潔有力，例如："30 Years of Precision. Zero Compromise."
- 視覺上要比圖2亮且正面

prompts.name: 圖4｜產品應用範圍圖 (Application Scene)
prompts.description: 場景化展示產品在實際環境中被使用，體現多元應用

templates.b2b:
A realistic wide-angle scene showing {product} being used in {specific_environment}.
Workers in the background are {action_description}.
{lighting_and_mood}.
The scene communicates real-world application and reliability.
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.
templates.consumer:
A lifestyle scene showing {product} being used naturally in {daily_scenario}.
{target_customer_description} interacting with the product in a genuine, relatable way.
{lighting_style}. Editorial quality, not overly staged.
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.

prompts.tips:
- B2B：顯示產品在實際生產/工作環境中的應用
- 消費品：日常使用場景，消費者與產品的互動
- 這張圖要回答「我的產品能幫我做什麼？」
- 可以展現多種使用場景或多個應用領域

prompts.name: 圖5｜PK 競爭優勢圖 (Competitive Edge)
prompts.description: 左右對比構圖，數據視覺化體現降維打擊

templates.b2b:
A split-composition comparison photograph on a clean factory workbench.
Left side: {competitor_description}. Label area: "Ordinary Supplier"
Right side: {our_solution}. Label area: "Our Solution"
Clean studio lighting. Neutral dark gray background.
Leave space at top and bottom for comparison data.
Text overlay top: "{comparison_title}"
Text overlay bottom: "{specific_comparison_data}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.
templates.consumer:
A clean side-by-side product comparison.
Left: {competitor_issues}. Right: {our_advantages}.
White studio background. Clear visual quality difference.
Text overlay: "{comparison_tagline}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.

example_comparisons.b2b: Left: a rough mold with visible surface defects, poor finish | Right: a flawless precision mold with mirror-like surface
example_comparisons.consumer: Left: faded colors, uneven stitching | Right: vibrant colors, perfect stitching, premium feel

prompts.tips:
- 左邊一定要是問題/競品，右邊是我們的解決方案
- 對比要視覺上非常清晰，一眼就能看出差異
- 如果有具體數據（精度、良率、交期），一定要顯示
- 沒有具體數據可用定性標語如 "The Difference Is Measurable"

prompts.name: 圖6｜Why Choose Us 信任背書圖
prompts.description: 展現公司規模、設備實力與年資，建立深度信任

templates.b2b:
A wide-angle professional corporate photograph of a large modern {industry} manufacturing facility.
Rows of {main_equipment} are clean and well-organized.
Technicians in uniforms working at their stations.
The environment feels established and technically capable.
{lighting_description}.
Leave space at top for credentials text overlay.
Text overlay: "{company_years} | {certifications} | {core_services}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.
templates.consumer:
A professional brand story photo showing {factory_or_brand_environment}.
Clean, well-lit production area with workers carefully crafting {product}.
Quality certificates and brand awards visible on the wall {if_available}.
Warm, trustworthy atmosphere.
Leave space at top for text overlay.
Text overlay: "{company_core_proposition}"
The image should look like a real photograph, not digital art or AI-generated illustration.

prompts.tips:
- 這是最後一張，目的是完全打消買家疑慮
- 展示真實的工廠環境、設備、認證、年資
- 讓買家感受到你是一個成熟、專業、有能力的供應商
- 如果有ISO認證、行業獎項，一定要拍進去或標註
- 人物要穿著整齊、看起來專業

prompts.name: 數據來源標記指南
prompts.description: 防止虛構數據，確保圖片可信度
prompts.template:
在圖片中使用數據時，必須標記來源：

| 標記 | 用途 | 示例 |
|------|------|------|
| [商家提供] | 商家在對話中明確說出的數字或事實 | "20 Years Experience [商家提供]" |
| [官網] | 從商家官網抓取的事實 | "ISO 9001 Certified [官網]" |
| [⚠️ 待補充] | 商家未提供，先留空 | "Defect Rate: [⚠️ 待補充]" |

**禁止捏造**年資、產能、認證、客戶數等具體數字。

缺失的數據應該使用占位符，讓商家稍後自行填入，或用通用標語替代（如 "Precision You Can Measure"）。

prompts.name: 六圖快速參考
prompts.description: 一份快速查閱的六圖框架總結
prompts.template:
# 六圖框架快速參考

| 圖序 | 圖片名稱 | 目的 | 情感訴求 | 關鍵信息 |
|------|---------|------|---------|----------|
| 圖1 | Hero Shot 主圖 | 第一眼吸引 | 「這看起來專業」 | 產品外觀、質感、精度 |
| 圖2 | Pain Point 痛點 | 喚起痛感 | 「我也有這個問題」 | 問題場景、緊張氛圍 |
| 圖3 | Why Now 理由 | 展示希望 | 「他們能幫我解決」 | 正向情境、解決方案 |
| 圖4 | Application 應用 | 展示價值 | 「這真的能用」 | 實際應用、多元場景 |
| 圖5 | Competitive Edge PK | 證明優勢 | 「他們比別人好」 | 對比數據、質量差異 |
| 圖6 | Why Choose Us 背書 | 建立信任 | 「他們可信」 | 規模、年資、認證、設備 |

## 購買者心理歷程

圖1 ➜ 圖2 ➜ 圖3 ➜ 圖4 ➜ 圖5 ➜ 圖6

看到產品 ➜ 有問題嗎 ➜ 能解決嗎 ➜ 怎麼用 ➜ 為什麼選你 ➜ 我相信你
